name: LiFx ServerUtility
description: Shared LiFxUtility TorqueScript helper library for the LiFx ServerAutoloader; the framework vendors this repository as a git submodule and already bundles utility.cs inside its art.zip release.
loadOrderNote: Framework-adjacent library: it defines the LiFxUtility package that ServerAutoloader's main.cs execs and activates, so it must be in place before any behavioural mod at 100.
